Rates & Availability

Villa rentals at Carlton Ridge are managed by Island Villas — check availability and reserve through their team below.

Price table

Rates

The villa comfortably sleeps up to 12 guests across the six double bedroom suites. The main house has four suites, and the garden residence has two suites. The main house can be booked separately for up to 8 guests, if you don’t need the full property.

6 Bedrooms (Up to 12 guests) 4 Bedrooms (Up to 8 guests)
Christmas US$2,500 US$1,667
Winter US$1,700 US$1,134
Summer US$1,200 US$800

Rates per night, plus 10% Shared Economy Levy and 2.5% Service Fee.

Bookings & availability

Your week at Carlton Ridge starts here

Carlton Ridge is available as the full six-bedroom residence for up to 12 guests, or as the four-bedroom main house for smaller groups.

Choose your dates below to see current availability and rates. Bookings are handled by our Barbados-based rental team at Island Villas, who can also help arrange airport transfers, chefs, drivers and experiences during your stay.
